g.text: Figure A3: what each local cell drew, gross and net, and the idle samples it

font-size: 11px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #52514e

g.text: round one; gross is the host counters over the whole run window; net subtracts that cell's own

text.style: font-size: 11px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #52514e

g.text: 300 second idle sample over the same window

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 12px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: a. watt-hours over each cell's eight runs

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 12px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: b. the 11 usable idle samples: 300 seconds with no machine running

text.style: font-size: 11px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #52514e

g.text: one taken before each local cell; a box and whiskers over the samples per sensor, median as

text.style: font-size: 11px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #52514e

g.text: the line, every sample a dot; the one sample that read a negative wattage is an anomaly,

text.style: font-size: 11px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #52514e
font-size: 11px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #52514e

g.text: The remaining sample, taken before Qwen 3.8 27B, think medium, read -183.8 W of CPU package power and

text.style: font-size: 11px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #52514e

g.text: 22.1 W of GPU power. A negative difference over the window is the counter wrapping, not a low reading,

text.style: font-size: 11px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #52514e

g.text: and the baseline path has no wraparound correction. That cell also has the largest gross bar above,

text.style: font-size: 11px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #52514e

g.text: 372.8 W implied over its window against 217.4 to 320.0 W for the other eleven, which section 7 reads as

text.style: font-size: 11px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #52514e

g.text: the check the record can bear on a wrap: a corrected one cannot show as a negative figure.
